Hardware details like zippers and buckles appear as smudged textures rather than functional 3D components. While the animals (cows and sheep) are rendered with high anatomical fidelity and realistic fur/wool textures, the object interaction (sheep on bags) shows slight physics inconsistencies (fabric deformation under hooves). The pose auditor flagged high risk for limb keypoints, though visually the animals look acceptable; the primary authenticity penalty comes from the inanimate objects.
